title: Kal Ho Naa Ho
lines: Every moment, life keeps changing its shape.
Tomorrow may or may not come.
original: Kal ho naa ho

title: Tujhe Dekha To Yeh Jaana Sanam
lines: Where shall we go from here? Let us die in your arms.
I saw you and only then learned: love is crazy, darling.
original: Tujhe dekha to ye jaana sanam

title: Chaiyya Chaiyya
lines: Whoever has love's shade overhead has heaven under the feet.
Walk, shade shade shade shade.
original: Chal chaiyya chaiyya chaiyya chaiyya

title: Mere Sapnon Ki Rani
lines: My whole life is passing by. When will you come?
Queen of my dreams, when will you come?
original: Mere sapnon ki rani kab aayegi tu

title: Yeh Dosti
lines: We may give up our breath, but will not leave your side.
This friendship, we will not break it.
original: Yeh dosti hum nahin todenge

title: Kabhi Kabhie Mere Dil Mein
lines: It is as if you were manufactured just for me.
Sometimes a thought comes into my heart.
original: Kabhi kabhie mere dil mein khayal aata hai

title: Lag Ja Gale
lines: Maybe in this lifetime we will not have another meeting.
Attach yourself to my neck, this lovely night may not return.
original: Lag ja gale ke phir ye haseen raat ho na ho

title: Ek Ladki Ko Dekha To
lines: Like a blooming rose, like a poet's dream.
I saw one girl and it felt like this.
original: Ek ladki ko dekha to aisa laga

title: Pehla Nasha
lines: What should I do with my condition, O restless heart?
First daze, first haze. New love, new waiting.
original: Pehla nasha, pehla khumaar

title: Didi Tera Devar Deewana
singer: Lata Mangeshkar and S. P. Balasubrahmanyam
lines: He keeps scattering bird feed for the girls.
Sister, your husband's younger brother has gone mad.
original: Didi tera devar deewana

title: Chura Ke Dil Mera
lines: Having flown away my sleep, where did you go?
Having stolen my heart, the fair girl walked off.
original: Chura ke dil mera goriya chali

title: Mehndi Laga Ke Rakhna
lines: Keep the palanquin decorated. Your lover is coming to collect you.
Keep the henna applied.
original: Mehndi laga ke rakhna, doli saja ke rakhna

title: Kuch Kuch Hota Hai
lines: You came near and smiled. Who knows what dreams you showed me.
Now my heart neither wakes nor sleeps. Something something happens.
original: Kya karoon haaye, kuch kuch hota hai

title: Bole Chudiyan
singer: Udit Narayan, Alka Yagnik and others
lines: Oh, I have become yours, my beloved.
The bangles are talking. The bracelet is talking.
original: Bole chudiyan, bole kangna

title: Tum Hi Ho
lines: We cannot live without you now. Without you, what am I?
Because only you, now only you. Life is only you.
original: Kyunki tum hi ho, ab tum hi ho

title: Channa Mereya
lines: Okay, I am leaving. Remember me in your prayers.
My moon, my moon. O dear friend, dear friend.
original: Accha chalta hoon, duaon mein yaad rakhna

title: Kesariya
lines: If I touch it with my hand, I get dyed.
Your love is saffron-coloured, beloved.
original: Kesariya tera ishq hai piya

title: Tip Tip Barsa Paani
lines: The water has set something on fire.
Drip drip fell the water.
original: Tip tip barsa paani, paani ne aag lagayi

title: Ek Do Teen
lines: I wait for you counting days. Come, beloved, spring is here.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine.
original: Ek do teen, char paanch chhe saat aath nau

title: Jai Ho
lines: Come, come, my life, under the tent.
Come under the blue sky with gold embroidery. Victory be!
original: Aaja aaja jind shamiyane ke tale

title: Chak De India
lines: Do something, do something, every vein of mine is boiling.
Lift it up, oh lift it up, my country.
original: Kuch kariye, kuch kariye

title: Maa
lines: I never tell you, but I am afraid of the dark.
I do not show it, but I worry about you, Mother.
original: Main kabhi batlata nahin, par andhere se darta hoon main maa

title: Aal Izz Well
singer: Sonu Nigam, Shaan and Swanand Kirkire
lines: What does the hen know about what will become of the egg?
When life is out of control, make your lips round and whistle.
original: Jab life ho out of control, hothon ko kar ke gol

title: Badtameez Dil
lines: It will not listen, it will not listen.
Ill-mannered heart, ill-mannered heart, ill-mannered heart.
original: Badtameez dil, maane na

title: Tera Ban Jaunga
lines: My roads go only up to you. Only on you do I have rights.
I will become yours.
original: Tera ban jaunga

title: Tere Bina Zindagi Se
lines: Without you, life is still there, but it is not life.
Without you, I have no complaint against life.
original: Tere bina zindagi se koi shikwa to nahin

title: Tum Se Hi
lines: This is not winning, and it is not losing either.
From you alone the day happens and the grey evening comes.
original: Tum se hi din hota hai

title: Kajra Re
singer: Alisha Chinai, Shankar Mahadevan and Javed Ali
lines: All my peace is ruined. Cruel one, take your gaze away.
Kohl, O kohl, your black black eyes.
original: Kajra re kajra re, tere kaare kaare naina

title: Tere Mast Mast Do Nain
singer: Rahat Fateh Ali Khan and Shreya Ghoshal
lines: They took away the peace of my heart.
Your two carefree, carefree eyes.
original: Tere mast mast do nain, mere dil ka le gaye chain

title: Mere Desh Ki Dharti
lines: The soil keeps spitting out gold, diamonds and pearls.
The ground of my country spits out gold.
original: Mere desh ki dharti sona ugle

title: Chhod Do Aanchal
lines: Even the world is crazy about these ways of yours.
Let go of my scarf. What will the world say?
original: Chhod do aanchal zamana kya kahega

title: Yeh Shaam Mastani
lines: Someone pulls my string and takes me towards you.
This carefree evening keeps making me dizzy.
original: Yeh shaam mastani madhosh kiye jaaye

title: Zindagi Ek Safar Hai Suhana
lines: Who here knows what will happen tomorrow?
Life is one pleasant trip.
original: Zindagi ek safar hai suhana

title: Awaara Hoon
lines: In my misfortune, I am a star of the sky.
I am a wanderer. A wanderer I am.
original: Awaara hoon, ya gardish mein hoon

title: Mera Joota Hai Japani
lines: These trousers are English, on my head a red Russian hat.
My shoe is from Japan, but still my heart is Indian.
original: Mera joota hai Japani

title: O Mere Sona Re
lines: I will give up my life, just do not separate.
O my gold, gold, gold.
original: O mere sona re sona re

title: Chura Liya Hai Tumne
lines: You changed my life, darling. Now do not you change.
You have stolen my heart, so do not steal your eyes.
original: Chura liya hai tumne jo dil ko

title: Aaj Phir Jeene Ki Tamanna Hai
lines: Today again I have plans to die.
Today again I have a desire to live.
original: Aaj phir jeene ki tamanna hai

title: Kora Kagaz Tha Yeh Man Mera
lines: Your name has been written on it.
This mind of mine was a blank sheet of paper.
original: Kora kagaz tha ye man mera

title: Papa Kehte Hain
lines: But nobody knows where my destination is.
Father says I will make a big name for myself.
original: Papa kehte hain bada naam karega

title: Ae Mere Humsafar
lines: Listen, the destination of love is calling out.
O my co-passenger, just one small wait.
original: Ae mere humsafar, ek zara intezaar

title: Mere Angne Mein
lines: Only the one who has a name gets a bad name.
What is your business in my courtyard?
original: Mere angne mein tumhara kya kaam hai

title: Khaike Paan Banaraswala
lines: The lock on the closed brain opens up.
After eating that betel leaf from Varanasi.
original: Khaike paan Banaras wala, khul jaye band akal ka tala

title: O Saathi Re
lines: In flowers, in buds, in the lanes of dreams.
O companion, what is the point of living without you?
original: O saathi re, tere bina bhi kya jeena

title: Ho Gaya Hai Tujhko To Pyaar Sajna
lines: Deny it a hundred thousand times, darling.
You have now gone and caught love, darling.
original: Ho gaya hai tujhko to pyaar sajna

title: Pardesi Pardesi
singer: Udit Narayan, Alka Yagnik and Sapna Awasthi
lines: Do not go, leaving me behind.
O foreigner, foreigner.
original: Pardesi pardesi jaana nahin

title: Jaadu Teri Nazar
lines: Say yes or say no, you are my Kiran.
Your gaze is magic and you smell like perfume.
original: Jaadu teri nazar, khushboo tera badan

title: Suraj Hua Maddham
lines: Why has this sky started to melt?
The sun went dim and the moon started burning.
original: Suraj hua maddham, chaand jalne laga

title: Kuch To Hua Hai
lines: For two or four days, everything has seemed different.
Something has happened. Something has become.
original: Kuch to hua hai, kuch ho gaya hai

title: Yeh Jo Des Hai Tera
lines: This is the bond that can never break.
This land that is yours has called out to you.
original: Yeh jo des hai tera, swades hai tera

title: Ye Haseen Vadiyan
singer: S. P. Balasubrahmanyam and K. S. Chithra
lines: Where have we reached, my beloved?
These beautiful valleys, this open sky.
original: Ye haseen vadiyan, ye khula aasman

title: Dil Hai Chhota Sa
lines: An innocent wish of a fun-filled mind.
The heart is small, and so is the wish.
original: Dil hai chhota sa, chhoti si aasha

title: Agar Tum Saath Ho
lines: Stop for a moment so this heart can steady itself.
If you are with me.
original: Pal bhar thehar jaao, dil ye sambhal jaaye

title: Sun Raha Hai
lines: You are listening, right? Why am I crying?
You are listening, right? I am crying.
original: Sun raha hai na tu, ro raha hoon main

title: Galliyan
lines: I am quite fond of these lanes.
Your lanes, lanes, your lanes.
original: Teri galliyan, galliyan teri galliyan

title: Tujh Mein Rab Dikhta Hai
lines: My head keeps bowing. Friend, what do I do?
I see God in you. Friend, what do I do?
original: Tujh mein rab dikhta hai

title: Haule Haule
lines: Slowly, slowly the medicine starts working.
Slowly, slowly the breeze touches you.
original: Haule haule se dawa lagti hai

title: Ae Dil Hai Mushkil
lines: Step aside a little, dodge a little, my darling.
O heart, it is hard to live here. This is Bombay.
original: Ae dil hai mushkil jeena yahan

title: Sar Jo Tera Chakraaye
lines: If your head is spinning or your heart is sinking,
come close to me, dear. Why panic?
original: Sar jo tera chakraaye, ya dil dooba jaaye

title: Kya Hua Tera Wada
lines: The day my heart forgets you will be my last day.
What happened to that oath and that intention of yours?
original: Kya hua tera wada, wo kasam wo irada

title: Bachna Ae Haseeno
lines: Lover of beauty, enemy of beauty, my style is different, friends.
Beware, O lovely ladies. Look, I have arrived.
original: Bachna ae haseeno, lo main aa gaya

title: Musafir Hoon Yaaron
lines: I just have to keep walking, just keep walking.
I am a traveller, friends. No home, no address.
original: Musafir hoon yaaron, na ghar hai na thikana

title: Ruk Jaana Nahin
lines: Walk on thorns and you will find the shadows of spring.
Do not stop anywhere after losing.
original: Ruk jaana nahin tu kahin haar ke

title: Ek Pyaar Ka Nagma Hai
lines: Life is nothing else, only your and my story.
It is one love song, a flowing of waves.
original: Ek pyaar ka nagma hai, maujon ki rawani hai

title: Kuch To Log Kahenge
lines: It is the job of people to talk.
People will certainly say something.
original: Kuch to log kahenge, logon ka kaam hai kehna

title: Chingari Koi Bhadke
lines: If the monsoon itself sets fire, who will put it out?
If some spark flares up, the rains put it out.
original: Chingari koi bhadke, to saawan use bujhaye

title: Main Shayar To Nahin
lines: Since I saw you, poetry has come to me.
I am not a poet, though, O lovely one.
original: Main shayar to nahin, magar ae haseen

title: Tere Jaisa Yaar Kahan
lines: The world will remember your story and mine.
Where is a friend like you, where is such friendship?
original: Tere jaisa yaar kahan, kahan aisa yaarana

title: Jeena Yahan Marna Yahan
lines: Where else is there to go?
To live here, to die here.
original: Jeena yahan, marna yahan, iske siva jaana kahan

title: Dost Dost Na Raha
lines: Life, I no longer trust you.
The friend did not stay a friend, love did not stay love.
original: Dost dost na raha, pyaar pyaar na raha

title: Pyar Kiya To Darna Kya
lines: I loved, I did not steal. Why sigh in secret?
Once you have loved, why be afraid?
original: Pyar kiya to darna kya

title: Abhi Na Jao Chhod Kar
lines: The heart is not full yet.
Do not leave me and go just now.
original: Abhi na jao chhod kar, ke dil abhi bhara nahin

title: Ajeeb Dastan Hai Yeh
lines: What destinations are these? Neither of us could figure it out.
This is a strange tale. Where does it start, where end?
original: Ajeeb dastan hai yeh, kahan shuru kahan khatam

title: Lakdi Ki Kaathi
singer: Gauri Bapat, Gurpreet Kaur and Vanita Mishra
lines: Someone hit the horse's tail with a hammer.
A stick of wood, and on the stick, a horse.
original: Lakdi ki kaathi, kaathi pe ghoda

title: Nani Teri Morni
alternates: Nani Teri Morni Ko Mor Le Gaye
lines: Whatever was left, the black thieves took.
Grandmother, the peacock took away your peahen.
original: Nani teri morni ko mor le gaye

title: Zindagi Ki Yahi Reet Hai
lines: Only after losing does winning come.
This is the custom of life.
original: Zindagi ki yahi reet hai, haar ke baad hi jeet hai

title: Jab Tak Hai Jaan
lines: O darling of the world, I will keep dancing.
As long as there is life, I will dance.
original: Jab tak hai jaan, jaane jahan, main naachungi

title: Dil Deewana
singer: Lata Mangeshkar and S. P. Balasubrahmanyam
lines: This lunatic will not understand when explained to.
The crazy heart does not agree without the beloved.
original: Dil deewana bin sajna ke maane na

title: Kabootar Ja Ja Ja
singer: Lata Mangeshkar and S. P. Balasubrahmanyam
lines: Deliver the first letter of first love to my beloved.
Pigeon, go go go. Pigeon, go go go.
original: Kabootar ja ja ja

title: Pehla Pehla Pyar Hai
lines: Knowing, yet unknowing. What kind of friend is mine?
First first love, first first time.
original: Pehla pehla pyaar hai, pehli pehli baar hai

title: Yeh Kaali Kaali Aankhen
lines: Since I saw you, darling, my condition has been bad.
These black black eyes, these fair fair cheeks.
original: Yeh kaali kaali aankhen, yeh gore gore gaal

title: Ae Zindagi Gale Laga Le
lines: I too have hugged every one of your sorrows, have I not?
O life, give me a hug.
original: Ae zindagi gale laga le

title: Tum Itna Jo Muskura Rahe Ho
lines: What grief is it that you are hiding?
You are smiling so much.
original: Tum itna jo muskura rahe ho

title: Chitthi Aayi Hai
lines: After many days, the soil of the homeland remembered us.
The letter has come, it has come, the letter has come.
original: Chitthi aayi hai, aayi hai

title: Sandese Aate Hain
singer: Sonu Nigam and Roop Kumar Rathod
lines: When will you come home?
Messages keep coming, and they torture us.
original: Sandese aate hain, hamein tadpaate hain

title: Teri Mitti
lines: May I bloom as a flower.
May I mix into your soil.
original: Teri mitti mein mil jaawan

title: Tere Sang Yaara
lines: You are the crazy night, I am a pale star.
With you, friend, spring is a happy colour.
original: Tere sang yaara, khush rang bahara

title: Bekhayali
lines: Why is separating necessary? This question comes to me.
Even in absent-mindedness, only the thought of you comes.
original: Bekhayali mein bhi tera hi khayal aaye

title: Dil Diyan Gallan
lines: Matching eye with eye.
We will have heart's talks, sitting side by side.
original: Dil diyan gallan karaange naal naal beh ke

title: Jeene Laga Hoon
lines: More than before, I have begun dying on you.
I have started living more than before.
original: Jeene laga hoon pehle se zyada

title: Pehli Nazar Mein
lines: My heart has gone and become yours.
At first sight, how did you do magic?
original: Pehli nazar mein kaise jaadu kar diya

title: Ghoonghat Ki Aad Se
lines: Until the lover glances, the make-up remains incomplete.
From behind the veil, the sighting of the beloved stays incomplete.
original: Ghoonghat ki aad se dilbar ka

title: Srivalli
lines: Your eyes are a tempting milk fudge.
Your glimpse is a gold coin.
original: Teri jhalak asharfi, Srivalli

title: Kala Chashma
singer: Badshah, Neha Kakkar and Amar Arshi
lines: They look good on your fair face.
Black goggles really suit you.
original: Tenu kala chashma jachda ae
